whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Hungry house restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has a strategic location opposite Rajendra Nagar Terminal in Patna, but lacked a dedicated online menu and mobile ordering page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, digital menu, aur table reservation integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/hungryhouse

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Hungry house restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital food menu and direct WhatsApp ordering for commuters near Rajendra Nagar Terminal. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
